points.title: 流亡童年
points.description: 阿克巴出生于1542年，当时其父亲胡马雍被阿富汗舍尔沙王朝击败，流亡于信德省。阿克巴的童年充满了动荡和危险，他随父亲辗转于波斯和阿富汗地区。这段经历塑造了他坚韧的性格和军事才能。1555年，胡马雍在波斯萨法维王朝的支持下重占德里，但次年不幸去世，13岁的阿克巴被迫继承王位，由拜拉姆汗摄政。
points.descriptionEn: Akbar was born in 1542 when his father Humayun was defeated by the Afghan Sur Dynasty and was in exile in Sindh. Akbar's childhood was marked by turmoil and danger as he moved with his father between Persia and Afghanistan. This experience shaped his resilient character and military skills. In 1555, Humayun recaptured Delhi with the support of the Persian Safavid Dynasty, but died the following year. At just 13, Akbar ascended the throne with Bairam Khan as regent.

points.title: 登基与亲政
points.description: 1556年，阿克巴在德里正式加冕为莫卧儿帝国皇帝。初期由拜拉姆汗摄政，但在1560年，阿克巴发动政变，亲掌大权。他迅速平定了帝国各地的叛乱，包括第二次帕尼帕特战役中击败了阿富汗将领希姆。这一时期，阿克巴开始展现出卓越的军事才能和政治智慧，为后来的帝国扩张奠定了基础。
points.descriptionEn: In 1556, Akbar was formally crowned Emperor of the Mughal Empire in Delhi. Initially ruled by regent Bairam Khan, but in 1560, Akbar staged a coup to take power himself. He quickly suppressed rebellions across the empire, including defeating the Afghan general Hemu in the Second Battle of Panipat. During this period, Akbar demonstrated exceptional military talent and political wisdom, laying the foundation for future imperial expansion.

points.title: 帝国扩张
points.description: 阿克巴将首都迁至阿格拉，并开始了大规模的军事征服。他先后征服了拉贾斯坦、古吉拉特、马尔瓦和孟加拉等地区，使莫卧儿帝国版图空前扩大。1568-1569年，他征服了拉贾斯坦的堡垒；1573年征服古吉拉特；1576年征服孟加拉。这一时期，阿克巴不仅依靠军事力量，还通过联姻、怀柔等手段巩固统治，建立了中央集权的强大帝国。
points.descriptionEn: Akbar moved the capital to Agra and began large-scale military conquests. He successively conquered Rajasthan, Gujarat, Malwa, and Bengal, expanding the Mughal Empire to unprecedented size. From 1568-1569, he conquered the fortresses of Rajasthan; in 1573, Gujarat; in 1576, Bengal. During this period, Akbar not only relied on military force but also consolidated his rule through marriage and appeasement policies, establishing a powerful centralized empire.

points.title: 宗教改革
points.description: 1579年，阿克巴颁布了'不干涉敕令'，开始推行宗教宽容政策。他建立了'信仰大会'，邀请各宗教领袖进行辩论，并创立了'丁-伊拉希'（神圣宗教）这一融合伊斯兰教、印度教、耆那教和基督教教义的新宗教。1582年，他在法特普尔西格里建立了'信仰大会'总部。这一系列改革体现了阿克巴的宗教包容思想，促进了帝国内部不同民族和宗教的和谐共存。
points.descriptionEn: In 1579, Akbar issued the 'Infallibility Decree' and began implementing religious tolerance policies. He established the 'Ibadat Khana' (House of Worship), inviting religious leaders of various faiths to debate, and created 'Din-i-Ilahi' (Divine Faith), a new religion blending elements of Islam, Hinduism, Jainism, and Christianity. In 1582, he established the headquarters of the 'Ibadat Khana' in Fatehpur Sikri. These reforms reflected Akbar's religious包容思想 and promoted harmony among different ethnic and religious groups within the empire.

points.title: 晚年统治
points.description: 1585年后，阿克巴将首都迁至拉合尔，专注于帝国治理和行政改革。他建立了高效的行政体系，实行'曼萨卜达尔'军衔制度，改革税收制度，废除对非穆斯林的人头税。他还大力支持艺术、文学和建筑发展，建造了法特普尔西格里等宏伟建筑。1605年，阿克巴在拉合尔逝世，享年63岁。他的统治时期被公认为莫卧儿帝国的黄金时代，为后来的奥朗则布等统治者奠定了坚实基础。
points.descriptionEn: After 1585, Akbar moved the capital to Lahore, focusing on imperial governance and administrative reforms. He established an efficient administrative system, implemented the 'Mansabdar' military rank system, reformed the tax system, and abolished the jizya tax on non-Muslims. He also strongly supported the development of arts, literature, and architecture, building magnificent structures like Fatehpur Sikri. Akbar died in Lahore in 1605 at the age of 63. His reign is widely regarded as the golden age of the Mughal Empire, laying a solid foundation for later rulers like Aurangzeb.

supporter.zh: 阿克巴大帝被尊为印度历史上最伟大的统治者之一。他通过军事征服和智慧统治，建立了庞大而统一的莫卧儿帝国。他推行的宗教宽容政策、行政改革和文化融合，为印度次大陆带来了前所未有的和平与繁荣。阿克巴的统治时期被视为莫卧儿帝国的黄金时代，他的包容性统治理念至今仍被广泛赞誉，为多元文化社会的和谐共存提供了典范。
supporter.en: Akbar the Great is revered as one of the greatest rulers in Indian history. Through military conquest and wise governance, he established a vast and unified Mughal Empire. His policies of religious tolerance, administrative reforms, and cultural integration brought unprecedented peace and prosperity to the Indian subcontinent. Akbar's reign is considered the golden age of the Mughal Empire, and his inclusive governance philosophy continues to be widely praised as a model for harmonious coexistence in multicultural societies.

critic.zh: 批评者指出阿克巴的统治并非完全宽容，他对印度教徒的宽容政策更多是出于政治实用主义而非真正的宗教平等。他的军事征服伴随着大量暴力和破坏，特别是在拉贾斯坦地区的征服过程中。此外，他创立的'丁-伊拉希'宗教虽然体现了包容思想，但也被视为对传统宗教的干预和强制同化。阿克巴的中央集权政策也削弱了地方王公的权力，为后来的帝国衰落埋下了伏笔。
critic.en: Critics point out that Akbar's rule was not entirely tolerant, as his policies toward Hindus were more politically pragmatic than based on true religious equality. His military conquests were accompanied by significant violence and destruction, particularly during the conquest of Rajasthan. Additionally, his creation of 'Din-i-Ilahi', while reflecting inclusive thought, is seen by some as interference with traditional religions and forced assimilation. Akbar's centralization policies also weakened the power of local rulers, sowing seeds for the empire's eventual decline.

objective.zh: 从历史学角度看，阿克巴是一位复杂而多面的统治者，其统治策略融合了军事力量、政治智慧和文化包容。他既是一位征服者，也是一位改革家；既维护了伊斯兰教的地位，又尊重印度教等本土宗教。在流行文化中，阿克巴常被塑造为印度多元文化的象征，其与拉贾普特公主贾达拉的婚姻故事被广泛传颂。历史学界普遍认为，阿克巴的统治代表了印度次大陆历史上少有的跨文化融合时期，为南亚次大陆的政治和文化发展产生了深远影响。
objective.en: From a historical perspective, Akbar was a complex and multifaceted ruler whose governance combined military strength, political wisdom, and cultural inclusivity. He was both a conqueror and a reformer; upholding Islam's position while respecting indigenous religions like Hinduism. In popular culture, Akbar is often portrayed as a symbol of India's multicultural heritage, with his marriage story to Rajput princess Jodha widely celebrated. Historians generally agree that Akbar's reign represented a rare period of cross-cultural integration in the Indian subcontinent, profoundly influencing the political and cultural development of South Asia.

self.zh: 一个国家若不能容纳所有宗教，就像一个身体不能容纳所有肢体一样。
self.en: A country that cannot accommodate all religions is like a body that cannot accommodate all its limbs.

others.zh: 阿克巴是历史上最伟大的君主之一，他不仅征服了领土，更征服了人心。
others.en: Akbar was one of the greatest monarchs in history, who not only conquered territories but also conquered hearts.
